headline: Woodside Exits Greater Sunrise Gas Project in Timor-Leste
summary: Australian energy firm Woodside Energy sold its stake in the long-delayed Greater Sunrise gas development off Timor-Leste, opening the way for potential investment from Chinese partners.
why: Greater Sunrise holds vast undeveloped offshore natural gas reserves critical for Timor-Leste's government revenues.

impacts.name: Woodside Energy Group Ltd
impacts.why: Exiting stagnant greenfield projects reallocates capital to core producing assets.
